C. P. Brown’s dictionary of the Telugu words of the vernacular, mixed with Sanskrit, Persian and Hindustani, the work of the great nineteenth-century scholar of Telugu (Madras, 1854). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by Google from a copy in Oxford University; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Dictionary of mixed Telugu · Charles Philip Brown · 1854, 170 scanned pages. Published 1854; Charles Philip Brown died 1884; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
